aggregation_stories.title: Maryland Appeals Google, Apple, Peacock’s Take Down of Ad Tax
aggregation_stories.summary: Maryland is appealing a state tax court's decision that struck down its first-in-the-nation digital advertising tax. The tax court had ruled that the tax unconstitutionally discriminates against large out-of-state companies like Google, Peacock TV, and Apple, and is preempted by the federal Internet Tax Freedom Act. This ruling could influence similar digital economy taxes in other states.
